judges: In Order To Bring Peace J.
trial_court: S.D.J.M., Panposh, Rourkela (G.R. Case No.1257 of 2012)
case_name: Biswajit Rout And Others vs State Of Orissa And Another

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Biswajit Rout and others (husband, wife, etc.)

facts_of_case: Petitioners filed a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. to quash criminal proceeding in G.R. Case No.1257 of 2012 arising out of Sector-7 Rourkela Mahila P.S. Case No.61 of 2012. The case was registered under Sections 498-A/506/34 of IPC and Section 4 of D.P. Act.

legal_principles.principle: Criminal proceedings should be quashed in the interest of justice to bring peace and stability in the lives of parties.
legal_principles.held: Considering the above facts and submissions of the learned counsel for the parties, regard being had to the interest of justice, it is just and proper that this criminal proceeding should be quashed.

legal_principles.principle: Permanent alimony received by the opposite party is a relevant factor in considering whether to quash criminal proceedings.
legal_principles.held: It is submitted that in view of such divorce between the parties, no fruitful purpose would be served in the continuation of the criminal proceeding which should be quashed.

outcome.final_order: The criminal proceeding is quashed in the interest of justice to bring peace and stability in the lives of the parties.
